● Actual ◌ Projected
Projection assumptions: flat {{ growthRateLabel }} contact-volume growth from a {{ baseTicketsLabel }}/yr Email+Chat+SMS baseline · Gorgias is a flat annual fee paid quarterly (Helpdesk + SMS with per-unit overage past cap; AI Agent steps up the graduated tier schedule, cheaper per interaction at higher tiers) · Kustomer's current $20,666/yr covers seats only, excluding the failed AI automation add-on already paid for and abandoned separately, and ends Aug 31, 2026 · FlipCX cost and automation rate are independently configurable above · Grupo NOA digital labor savings modeled at $7.55/hr against real schedule hours (2 agents × 40 hrs/wk, 35 hr/wk floor per agent), not a per-contact rate; Phone/FlipCX labor kept on the existing per-contact model · {{ realizedPct }}% of freed capacity assumed actually captured via reduced/cross-trained scheduling. Any month already present in the live sheet always shows as Actual, regardless of this projection.
